com.esignal.jstandard.beans.history

Interface HistoricalBar

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultHistoricalBar, IntradayHistoricalBar

    public interface HistoricalBar
    Purpose of this class is to hold information of Historical Bars.

    Information include symbol, date, open, high, low, close, open interest and volume.

    Since:
    01-001-0009
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
